item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 11 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Seven to nine, nearly ten millimetres of rain, so today the sky is still wearing its duvet and sweating through it. Then Thursday it throws the duvet off. Clear, dry, three to seven, and clear skies mean nothing holds the heat in, so dawn hits zero Friday and minus two…

item.title: Briefing — Wednesday 04 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today eight to ten, cloudy, under a millimetre of rain, wind up to seven metres a second. Thursday: same, photocopied. Friday is the only day with ambition, two point six millimetres, a drizzle with a business card. Then Sunday. Three degrees at dawn, partly cloudy,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 10 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Cloudy, four to ten, and nearly nineteen millimetres of rain. Wednesday adds another twelve at a flat seven to nine, so wellies, proper coat, and fog lights, because London has a pollution alert for fog this morning. Then Thursday and Friday go clear and bone dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Tuesday 03 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today seven to twelve, fair, one point four millimetres of rain, wind up to seven metres a second. Fair, with rain. Sure. Then Wednesday to Friday: ten degrees, cloudy, dry as a spreadsheet. Saturday brings exactly one point four millimetres again, the sky ordering the…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 12 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Two to seven, clear, dry. Lovely. Enjoy it, because this is the free trial. Friday, clear, dry, dawn around zero. Saturday, still dry, minus two at dawn, so de-ice like an adult. Then Sunday auto-renews: nearly five millimetres, four to eleven, with a drizzle fee…

item.title: Briefing — Thursday 05 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today seven to ten, cloudy, under half a millimetre of rain, light wind. Friday, nearly three millimetres, and the highs sit at ten through Saturday, so you do not even get the dignity of proper cold. Then it falls down the stairs. Sunday dawn, four degrees. Monday,…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 08 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today five to seven, cloudy, a token drizzle, no personality whatsoever. Monday is five to ten and bone dry, a free pass, so enjoy it, you ungrateful lump. Then Tuesday. Twenty-four point two millimetres. The sky has been saving up and Tuesday is it emptying the piggy…

item.title: Briefing — Sunday 01 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: six to ten, cloudy, two millimetres of rain, light wind, and the BBC warns of thick fog across England and Wales. You will be driving blind, so slow down, genius. Monday matches: seven to twelve, another two millimetres. Then the sky pulls a grey lid over the…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 31 October 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to fourteen, partly cloudy, dry, light wind. After the wettest week in two years, the sky has gone teetotal. Sunday it relapses: six to ten, cloudy, two millimetres, one sad drink. Then Monday seven to twelve, dry and windier, Tuesday and Wednesday dry,…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 14 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Last orders. Today is the final dry day: minus two at dawn, up to eight, no rain, light wind. Use it or lose it. Wash the car, hang the washing, ring your mother. Because at closing time the sky buys everyone a round. Sunday, nineteen point three millimetres, wind…

item.title: Briefing — Saturday 07 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today four to ten, cloudy, bone dry, so the wet Saturday evaporated and you lose your excuse. Sunday and Monday copy it, Monday dawning at two degrees, the coldest of the week. Then the rain applies for a job. Tuesday is the intern, one point three millimetres.…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 09 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Fog this morning, so the school run is a blindfold game. Today four to nine, dry, partly cloudy, enjoy it, you will not be given another. Because Tuesday the sky leaves the bath running. Fifty-four and a half millimetres Tuesday, forty-eight Wednesday, over a hundred…

item.title: Briefing — Monday 02 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today: seven to eleven, partly cloudy, two millimetres of rain, wind up to seven metres a second. Tuesday and Wednesday the same, barely a drizzle, Thursday cloudy and bone dry. Yesterday I called the week's rain a rounding error. Friday would like a word. Six…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 13 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Friday the thirteenth, and a doomsday study says the world ends today. It fails, because the forecast is dry. Zero to seven, clear, no rain. Saturday the same, minus one at dawn, so scrape the car like an adult. Then Sunday ruins it. Yesterday I said nearly five…

item.title: Briefing — Friday 06 November 2026
item.description:
Weather.
Today six to eleven, cloudy, a fifth of a millimetre, which is the sky clearing its throat. Saturday is the wet one, two point six millimetres, the week's wettest, and naturally it lands on your day off. Monday is the cold one, four to seven, fair and bone dry, smug…
